name: fmp_revenue_by_geography
description:
Revenue split by geographic segment for one company by period from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/revenue-geographic-segmentation as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, sent as given, e.g. AAPL).
For the split by product or business line use fmp_revenue_by_product.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
